notes: The supplied event log is authoritative even when recorded timestamps do not align with board unlocks. Corp Beast unlocks with the second grid and remains outside the 30 race tiles; its shield + elixir + sigil recipe is inferred from the supplied event log because the planner does not define that checklist.
